method.contactSheets: Eight temporary contact sheets, each showing up to12 side-by-side source/output pairs, 93 outputs total. No cropping of contact thumbnails; native aspect ratio preserved.
method.duplicateCheck: SHA256 comparison of all 363 catalogue assets; no duplicate group involving a continuation output.
method.continuation: Each accepted continuation output was individually inspected against its actual neutral identity reference by the generating reviewer. Recorded reviews and native file hashes are included below.

limits: This review checks obvious visual identity continuity, framing and costume classification; it does not certify canonical anatomy, canonical costume design or literal1:1/pixel-for-pixel fidelity.
Source identities often derive from previous generated full-body sprites and partial original references; newly visible legs/arms/torso cannot be treated as canonically established.
Most new images use finely shaded anime/pixel-sprite rendering; they are static one-frame assets, not animation sheets.
No pixel editing was applied to delivered images. Contact sheets and enlarged/composited crops are temporary QA artifacts only.
The197 baseline images were checked for SHA duplicates but not reopened for a new full aesthetic audit; requested scope is the96 additions.
